subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should Gateway use when a configured channel plugin fails before channel registration: warn-and-continue with an audit summary, fail-fast, or a narrower status/doctor-only diagnostic?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but changing startup failure semantics affects compatibility, operator expectations, plugin loading, and message-channel availability.

options.title: Warn-and-Continue Audit
options.body: Add a startup summary that includes configured channels that failed before registration, preserving current Gateway availability while making the failure visible.

options.title: Fail Fast on Configured Channel Failure
options.body: Abort readiness or startup when a configured channel cannot register, trading clearer failure for possible upgrade breakage.

options.title: Status/Doctor Only
options.body: Keep Gateway startup behavior unchanged and rely on status/doctor diagnostics for missing or failed channel plugins.

recommendation.title: Warn-and-Continue Audit
recommendation.body: Add a startup summary that includes configured channels that failed before registration, preserving current Gateway availability while making the failure visible.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears most connected to recent plugin loader and external channel startup-planner decisions for the affected behavior.
